turns.q: What should I do if the tracking never updates?
turns.replyTail:
:

What should I do if the tracking never updates?

04:34 PM

I know it’s stressful when tracking seems stuck. If the package has already shipped and the tracking is not updating, the best next step is to check directly with FedEx for the most current transit details, since once it leaves our warehouse the shipment is in the carrier’s hands. We are not able to speed it up or offer refunds or credits for carrier delays, but FedEx will have the best real-time update on any transit issue.

When tracking shows delivered but you didn’t receive the package, please verify the delivery address and also check with anyone who might have accepted it on your behalf (neighbors, roommates, friends, family, or a doorman). It can also help to wait 2 business days after the posted delivery date in case the carrier marks it delivered a bit early or leaves it in a discreet spot.
